name: S3 presigned URL
description: S3 presigned URL: an object URL whose query string carries SigV4 authentication parameters (X-Amz-Algorithm, X-Amz-Credential, X-Amz-Date, X-Amz-SignedHeaders, X-Amz-Signature), documented as a bearer capability for the signing principal.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. A capability URL rather than a fixed-format token: the contract records which parts grant access, not a detection grammar.
